notice: Signature questions for the hackathon demo: one memorable, book-specific detail per famous target, so a reader who remembers it can confirm the book quickly. Answers are AI general knowledge (status ai_recall, no source, reviewed=false), NOT a person's review. The named target gets p_yes 0.9; books listed in 'unknown_for' could plausibly match and stay unknown; every other single-book or series target of the research catalog gets 0.1 (p_yes stays > 0, so a 'Yes' never hard-eliminates them). Applied by scripts/add_signature_questions.ts, re-run after every catalog rebuild.

questions.text: Does the hero have a lightning-bolt scar on the forehead?
questions.ko: 주인공의 이마에 번개 모양 흉터가 있나요?
questions.definition: The main character carries a lightning-bolt-shaped scar on the forehead.

questions.text: Is the main setting a boarding school for witches and wizards?
questions.definition: Much of the story happens at a residential school that teaches magic.

questions.text: Is a sport played on flying broomsticks part of it?
questions.ko: 빗자루를 타고 날며 하는 운동 경기가 나오나요?
questions.definition: Characters play a team sport while flying on broomsticks.

questions.text: Are teenagers forced to fight to the death in a televised contest?
questions.ko: 청소년들이 TV로 중계되는 죽음의 경기에서 싸워야 하나요?
questions.definition: Young people are made to kill each other in a broadcast competition.

questions.text: Does a girl fall in love with a vampire whose skin sparkles in sunlight?
questions.ko: 햇빛을 받으면 피부가 반짝이는 뱀파이어와 소녀가 사랑에 빠지나요?
questions.definition: A romance between a girl and a vampire whose skin glitters in the sun.

questions.text: Do children reach a magical land through a wardrobe?
questions.ko: 아이들이 옷장을 통해 마법의 나라로 가나요?
questions.definition: Children step through a wardrobe into another world.

questions.text: Must a powerful ring be destroyed?
questions.definition: The quest is to destroy a ring of great power.

questions.text: Is the hero the son of a Greek god?
questions.definition: The main character is a demigod, the child of a Greek god.

questions.text: Do children win golden tickets to tour a factory?
questions.ko: 아이들이 황금 티켓을 얻어 공장을 구경하나요?
questions.definition: Golden tickets give a few children a tour of a factory.

questions.text: Does a ship's captain hunt a white whale?
questions.definition: A captain pursues a white whale.

questions.text: Does a girl follow a yellow brick road?
questions.definition: A girl travels along a road paved with yellow bricks.

questions.text: Are dinosaurs brought back to life?
questions.definition: Dinosaurs are recreated or revived in the story.

corrections.notice: Cells that contradict how readers remember the book, found while analysing why the Harry Potter series was hard to find (a 0.9 label vs a reader's 'No' costs the book about x5 each). They are set to unknown (no cell), never flipped.
